[[Nifling's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Nifling the Chained]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Varajar Fells]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Holy damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Smiting Prayers]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spells]] (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of Smiting Prayers spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer
